Write a list of disturbance layers to disk, and read it back

Source: R/wrapTerra.R
wrapTerraList.Rd

wrapTerraList() saves a list of vector layers grouped by sector and class, such as the disturbanceList of the anthropogenic disturbance modules: one .rds file per layer (a wrapped SpatVector), plus an index, theList.rds, holding each layer's file name by sector and class. With zipFiles = TRUE it also packs them into disturbanceList.zip, the archive unwrapTerraList() downloads.

Usage

wrapTerraList(terraList, generalPath, zipFiles = FALSE)

unwrapTerraList(terraList, generalPath)

Arguments

terraList

For wrapTerraList(), a list of lists of SpatVectors, named by sector and then by class.

For unwrapTerraList(), either the index (a list of lists of file names, as wrapTerraList() returns), or a character string. If theList.rds is in generalPath, the string is ignored and the index is read from there; otherwise the string is the URL of disturbanceList.zip, which is downloaded (unless it is already in generalPath) and extracted into generalPath by reproducible::prepInputs().

generalPath

Directory that holds, or will hold, theList.rds and the layer files.

zipFiles

Logical. Also write disturbanceList.zip to generalPath? Needs a zip program (see utils::zip()).

Value

wrapTerraList() returns the index invisibly: a list of lists of file names, named by sector and class. unwrapTerraList() returns a list of lists of SpatVectors with the same names.

Details

unwrapTerraList() reads such a list back. It looks for the layers in generalPath, whatever directory the index names, so an index written on another machine, or one holding full paths, still works.

Author

Tati Micheletti, Alex M. Chubaty

Examples

disturbanceList <- list(
  mining = list(
    mining = terra::vect("POLYGON ((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1, 0 0))", crs = "EPSG:3857")
  ),
  roads = list(roads = terra::vect("LINESTRING (0 0, 2 2)", crs = "EPSG:3857"))
)
generalPath <- file.path(tempdir(), "disturbanceList")
index <- wrapTerraList(disturbanceList, generalPath)
str(index)
#> List of 2
#>  $ mining:List of 1
#>   ..$ mining: chr "mining_mining.rds"
#>  $ roads :List of 1
#>   ..$ roads: chr "roads_roads.rds"

layers <- unwrapTerraList("theList.rds", generalPath)
#> Recovering mining_mining.rds
#> Recovering roads_roads.rds
layers$roads$roads
#> class       : SpatVector
#> geometry    : lines
#> dimensions  : 1, 0  (geometries, attributes)
#> extent      : 0, 2, 0, 2  (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)
#> coord. ref. : WGS 84 / Pseudo-Mercator (EPSG:3857)
